# Asset or Expense: What's the Difference for Your Business

## The Basic Distinction
### Asset
#### Becomes stronger over time
#### Retains its effect without further investment
### Expense
#### Requires ongoing payments
#### Disappears when stopped

## The Accounting and Practical Perspective
### Accounting definition
#### A controlled resource
#### Future benefits
### Practical definition
#### Testing through resilience
#### Accumulation of effect

## The Key Test
### Turn off advertising
### Evaluate the residual effect
### Ask the question
#### What will remain afterward

## What May Remain
### Brand function
### Operational value
### Contact base

## The Limits of Simplification
### Not an absolute criterion
### Initial diagnostics are needed

## Practical Conclusion
### Nothing remains
#### Risk of an expense-based model
### Only a brochure website
#### A reason to stop and think
